name: guo-jia-blessed-scion-enter-quest-or-draw
notes: Guo Jia, Blessed Scion (59ipqa91r2, GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities["59ipqa91r2:0"] / customDQHandlers["59ipqa91r2:0:Enter-1"]): "On Enter: You may put two quest counters on CARDNAME. If you don't, draw a card." The champion is patched directly to Guo Jia, Chosen Disciple (level 1) -- representing already having leveled up once WITHOUT re-testing that card's own On Enter -- so a single REAL level-up (1 -> 2, paid with 2 memory filler cards seeded on the same turn they're needed, since memory returns to hand at turn end) reaches Blessed Scion and fires its genuine On Enter. Verified live: answering YES to "Put 2 quest counters on Guo Jia?" sets the champion's Counters to {"quest":2}. Break/restore verified: commenting out the AddQuestCounters() call in the YES branch makes the fixture fail and restoring it passes again. (The separate 'Lineage Release -- Negate target activation or trigger that targets a Fatestone or Fatebound object you control' clause is not covered by this fixture.)

rulesClauses: On Enter: You may put two quest counters on CARDNAME. If you don't, draw a card.
